## What changed

Which field or stage, and its new meaning in one sentence.

## Why

What happened in the team or in a tool that made this change needed.

## Before you merge

- [ ] The owner named at the top of field-dictionary.md has approved this change
- [ ] CHANGELOG.md has a new line with today's date and who approved the change
- [ ] The Last reviewed date and the version at the top of field-dictionary.md are updated
- [ ] checks/field-tests.md has the new expected answer
- [ ] If the skill changed, both copies match
- [ ] No credential, token or client data is in this pull request
